decisions.proposed_text: Loại hàng mua・Số sở hữu

decisions.proposed_text: Hủy mua Jewel và vật phẩm
decisions.reason: The help/title context makes 'Về việc' redundant; the shorter title preserves cancellation of Jewel and other-item purchases.

decisions.proposed_text: Đạt giới hạn, không thể đổi
decisions.reason: The concise cause-first warning preserves that the ownership cap blocks exchange without the verbose possession phrase.

decisions.proposed_text: Ngoài hạn nhiệm vụ sự kiện
decisions.reason: The event context makes the duplicated 'giới hạn' wording unnecessary; the compact label still states that the event mission period is over.

decisions.proposed_text: Không mở được chi tiết thẻ
decisions.reason: Using the canonical compact 'chi tiết thẻ' form keeps the support-card detail failure clear with substantially less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Khôi phục hoàn tất
decisions.reason: The process noun is redundant in a completion status; the compact phrase preserves that restoration has finished.

decisions.proposed_text:
Đã mua sản phẩm
Về màn hình tiêu đề để cập nhật
decisions.reason: Both source lines are preserved; the second line directly states the title-screen return needed to apply the purchase without passive filler.

decisions.proposed_text: Số sở hữu khác
decisions.reason: The item context already supplies what is owned, so the compact count label can omit the repeated 'vật phẩm' wording.

decisions.proposed_text: Mảnh đổi dùng để nâng Sao
decisions.reason: Repository translations already establish 'nâng Sao' for this mechanic; the shorter wording preserves that exchanged fragments can be used for it.

decisions.proposed_text: Thời hạn: tự gia hạn 1 tháng
decisions.reason: Dropping the redundant 'hiệu lực' and 'tự động' expansion keeps the one-month auto-renewal term while fitting the label.

decisions.proposed_text: Gia hạn gói Uma thất bại
decisions.reason: The subscription screen supplies the notification context, and compact 'Uma' is permitted for cramped UI titles; the renewal-failure meaning is unchanged.

decisions.proposed_text: Thanh toán trùng gói Uma
decisions.reason: Removing the generic notification wrapper and using compact 'Uma' preserves the duplicate-subscription-payment warning in a much shorter title.

decisions.proposed_text: Gia hạn gói Uma
decisions.reason: The dialog context already communicates that this is a notice; the compact title preserves the Uma subscription renewal topic.

decisions.proposed_text:
Đã cập nhật thanh toán
Về màn hình tiêu đề
decisions.reason: The source newline count is preserved; the compact first line keeps the payment-status update and the second keeps the title-screen return action.

decisions.proposed_text:
Trạng thái gói đã đổi
Về màn hình tiêu đề
decisions.reason: Both source lines are preserved; subscription context allows 'gói' as a compact reference while keeping the status-change and return-to-title meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: Không thể huấn luyện
decisions.reason: The selected training is already visible on the screen, so 'này' and the helper verb 'thực hiện' can be removed without changing the restriction.

decisions.proposed_text: Từ hạng {0} được dự thi
decisions.reason: The compact eligibility label preserves the rank placeholder and minimum-rank condition while removing verbose participation wording.

decisions.proposed_text: Từ {0} fan được dự thi
decisions.reason: The shorter eligibility label preserves the fan-count placeholder and minimum threshold without the long 'có thể tham gia khi có' construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Tập {0} <color=#2E85E6>không được nữa</color>
decisions.reason: The placeholder and color tags are preserved exactly; compact 'Tập' and the shorter failure phrase keep that this training can no longer be performed.

decisions.proposed_text: Không thể đua ngoài mục tiêu
decisions.reason: The training-mode context makes 'cuộc đua' and 'tham gia' redundant; the compact warning still forbids races outside the target objective.
